content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ANGRAU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University (ANGRAU) for filling temporary positions under advertisement number A2/1361/2026 at Bapatla, Andhra Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in this recruitment notification?
faq.answer: The notification advertises positions for Teaching Associate and Teaching Assistant in the Department of Food Science and Technology on a temporary and contractual basis.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for ANGRAU recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly through a Walk-in interview. Eligible candidates are required to directly attend the interview venue along with all necessary original certificates and self-attested copies.

faq.question: Q4. What is the scheduled date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 12 October 2026. Certificate verification begins at 9:00 AM, and the interview process commences at 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Teaching Associate?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Ph.D. in Food Processing Technology OR a Master's degree in Food Technology/Food Science and Technology/Food Processing Technology along with a B.Tech degree and relevant teaching or research experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational requirement for Teaching Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Teaching Assistant post should possess a Master's degree in Food Technology, Food Science and Technology, Food Processing Technology, or Food Technology and Management with first division.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for Teaching Associate posts?
faq.answer: Teaching Associates with a Master's degree receive Rs. 61,000/- plus HRA per month, while those holding a Ph.D. degree receive Rs. 67,000/- plus HRA per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly stipend for the Teaching Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Teaching Assistant post will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 37,000/- plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q9. What is the age limit for male and female applicants?
faq.answer: For Teaching Associates, the maximum age is 40 years for men and 45 years for women. For Teaching Assistants, it is 35 years for men and 40 years for women.

faq.question: Q10. What is included in the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises certificate verification, a brief blackboard presentation of 2-3 minutes on a topic of the candidate's choice, followed by the personal interview.
